outline: Start with: Design and demonstrate an end-to-end Git workflow for a simulated software development team.
Document a shared-remote repository and branch strategy
Use feature branches, focused commits and review proposals
Resolve a controlled conflict and run regression checks
Protect shared branches and document credential/signature practices
Recover from a mistaken branch update
Demonstrate a tested backup and automated validation checklist
Verify all state changes and record actual output.
Use human review for collaboration policy, safety, and decision quality.
explanation: This is an evaluation outline, not a claim that a remote repository, CI pipeline or release was executed. A complete solution must include actual evidence from a disposable/authorized repository and describe assumptions or differences from the expected path.
